{"formal_statement": "theorem pow_mul (a : M) (m : \u2115) : \u2200 n, a ^ (m * n) = (a ^ m) ^ n | 0 => by rw [Nat.mul_zero, pow_zero, pow_zero]\n  | n + 1 => by rw [Nat.mul_succ, pow_add, pow_succ, pow_mul]", "full_name": "pow_mul", "informal_statement": "For any element $a$ in a monoid $M$ and any natural numbers $m$ and $n$, the power operation satisfies $a^{m \\cdot n} = (a^m)^n$."}

{"formal_statement": "theorem one_pow : \u2200 n, (1 : M) ^ n = 1 | 0 => pow_zero _\n  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, one_pow, one_mul]", "full_name": "one_pow", "informal_statement": "For any natural number $n$, the $n$-th power of the multiplicative identity $1$ in a monoid $M$ is equal to $1$, i.e., $1^n = 1$."}

{"formal_statement": "theorem pow_three' (a : M) : a ^ 3 = a * a * a := by rw [pow_succ, pow_two]", "full_name": "pow_three'", "informal_statement": "For any element $a$ in a monoid $M$, the third power of $a$ equals $a$ multiplied by itself three times, i.e., $a^3 = a \\cdot a \\cdot a$."}

{"formal_statement": "theorem Nat.ModEq.trans : a \u2261 b [MOD n] \u2192 b \u2261 c [MOD n] \u2192 a \u2261 c [MOD n] :=\n  Eq.trans", "full_name": "Nat.ModEq.trans", "informal_statement": "For any natural numbers $a$, $b$, $c$, and $n$, if $a \\equiv b \\pmod{n}$ and $b \\equiv c \\pmod{n}$, then $a \\equiv c \\pmod{n}$."}

results.match: Multiset.powerset - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Power Set of a Multiset.** Given a multiset $s$, its power set is the multiset containing all possible sub-multisets of $s$. This is defined by lifting the operation that generates all sublists of a representative list to the level of multisets, ensuring that the resulting collection is invariant under permutations of the original elements.
results.name: Multiset.powerset

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Submultisets of a Given Size.** For a natural number $n$ and a multiset $s$, the operation returns the multiset consisting of all submultisets of $s$ that have a cardinality of exactly $n$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multiset/Powerset.lean#L240-L243
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard

results.match: Multiset.card_powersetCard - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Cardinality of the Multiset of Submultisets of a Given Size.** For any multiset $s$ and any natural number $n$, the number of submultisets of $s$ with cardinality $n$ is equal to the binomial coefficient $\binom{|s|}{n}$, where $|s|$ denotes the cardinality of $s$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249f
results.name: Multiset.card_powersetCard

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_map - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Commutativity of Mapping and Submultisets of Fixed Size.** For any function $f: \alpha \to \beta$, any natural number $n$, and any multiset $s$ over $\alpha$, the multiset of all submultisets of size $n$ of the image of $s$ under $f$ is equal to the image of the multiset of all submultisets of $s$ of size $n$ under the induced mappin
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_map

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_coe' - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Equality of Multiset Powerset and Auxiliary Sublist Functions.** For any natural number $n$ and any list $l$, the multiset of all submultisets of $l$ with cardinality $n$ is equal to the result of the auxiliary function that computes sublists of $l$ of length $n$ and treats them as multisets. - https://github.com/leanprover-communit
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_coe'

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_self - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **The powerset of a multiset of a specific size.** For any multiset $s$, the collection of all sub-multisets of $s$ with cardinality equal to the cardinality of $s$ is the singleton multiset containing only $s$ itself. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multise
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_self

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_mono - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Monotonicity of the Powerset of a Fixed Cardinality.** For any natural number $n$, if a multiset $s$ is a submultiset of $t$, then the multiset of all submultisets of $s$ with cardinality $n$ is a submultiset of the multiset of all submultisets of $t$ with cardinality $n$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_mono

results.match: Multiset.powersetCardAux - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Sublists of a Fixed Length as Multisets.** Given a natural number $n$ and a list $l$, this function produces the list of all sublists of $l$ of length $n$, where each sublist is represented as a multiset. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multiset/Powerset.lea
results.name: Multiset.powersetCardAux

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_coe - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Submultisets of a Given Cardinality from a List.** For any natural number $n$ and any list $l$, the multiset of all submultisets of $l$ with cardinality $n$ is equal to the multiset obtained by taking all sublists of $l$ of length $n$ and treating each sublist as a multiset. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e33
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_coe

results.match: Multiset.card_powerset - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Cardinality of the Power Set of a Multiset.** For any multiset $s$, the cardinality of its power set is equal to $2$ raised to the power of the cardinality of $s$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multiset/Powerset.lean#L113-L115
results.name: Multiset.card_powerset

results.match: Multiset.powerset - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Power Set of a Multiset.** Given a multiset $s$, its power set is the multiset containing all possible sub-multisets of $s$. This is defined by lifting the operation that generates all sublists of a representative list to the level of multisets, ensuring that the resulting collection is invariant under permutations of the original elements.
results.name: Multiset.powerset

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Submultisets of a Given Size.** For a natural number $n$ and a multiset $s$, the operation returns the multiset consisting of all submultisets of $s$ that have a cardinality of exactly $n$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multiset/Powerset.lean#L240-L243
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_map - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Commutativity of Mapping and Submultisets of Fixed Size.** For any function $f: \alpha \to \beta$, any natural number $n$, and any multiset $s$ over $\alpha$, the multiset of all submultisets of size $n$ of the image of $s$ under $f$ is equal to the image of the multiset of all submultisets of $s$ of size $n$ under the induced mappin
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_map

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_coe' - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Equality of Multiset Powerset and Auxiliary Sublist Functions.** For any natural number $n$ and any list $l$, the multiset of all submultisets of $l$ with cardinality $n$ is equal to the result of the auxiliary function that computes sublists of $l$ of length $n$ and treats them as multisets. - https://github.com/leanprover-communit
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_coe'

results.match: Multiset.card_powersetCard - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Cardinality of the Multiset of Submultisets of a Given Size.** For any multiset $s$ and any natural number $n$, the number of submultisets of $s$ with cardinality $n$ is equal to the binomial coefficient $\binom{|s|}{n}$, where $|s|$ denotes the cardinality of $s$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249f
results.name: Multiset.card_powersetCard

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_self - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **The powerset of a multiset of a specific size.** For any multiset $s$, the collection of all sub-multisets of $s$ with cardinality equal to the cardinality of $s$ is the singleton multiset containing only $s$ itself. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multise
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_self

results.match: Multiset.powersetCard_mono - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Monotonicity of the Powerset of a Fixed Cardinality.** For any natural number $n$, if a multiset $s$ is a submultiset of $t$, then the multiset of all submultisets of $s$ with cardinality $n$ is a submultiset of the multiset of all submultisets of $t$ with cardinality $n$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336
results.name: Multiset.powersetCard_mono

results.match: Multiset.powersetCardAux - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Powerset] - **Sublists of a Fixed Length as Multisets.** Given a natural number $n$ and a list $l$, this function produces the list of all sublists of $l$ of length $n$, where each sublist is represented as a multiset. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/Data/Multiset/Powerset.lea
results.name: Multiset.powersetCardAux

results.match: Multiset.card_sym2 - [Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Sym] - **Cardinality of the Symmetric Square of a Multiset.** For any multiset $m$, the cardinality of its symmetric square (the multiset of all unordered pairs of its elements) is equal to the binomial coefficient $\binom{n+1}{2}$, where $n$ is the cardinality of $m$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9f
results.name: Multiset.card_sym2

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_toSubring - [Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Subring] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Restricted to a Subring.** For a polynomial $p$ whose coefficients all lie within a subring $T$, the $n$-th coefficient of $p$ viewed as a polynomial over $T$ is equal to the $n$-th coefficient of $p$ viewed as a polynomial over the original ring. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_toSubring

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_update - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Basic] - **Coefficient of an Updated Polynomial.** For a polynomial $p$ over a ring $R$, the sequence of coefficients of the polynomial obtained by updating the $n$-th coefficient of $p$ to a value $a$ is equal to the function obtained by updating the coefficient function of $p$ at index $n$ to $a$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mat
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_update

results.match: Polynomial.coeffs_ofSubring - [Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Subring] - **Coefficients of a Polynomial over a Subring.** For any polynomial $p$ defined over a subring $T$ of a ring $R$, the set of coefficients of $p$ when viewed as a polynomial in $R[X]$ is a subset of $T$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485ec3bc/Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomia
results.name: Polynomial.coeffs_ofSubring

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_mul_C - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Multiplied by a Constant.** For any polynomial $p$ over a semiring $R$, any natural number $n$, and any constant $a \in R$, the $n$-th coefficient of the product of $p$ and the constant polynomial $C(a)$ is equal to the product of the $n$-th coefficient of $p$ and $a$. - https://github.com/leanprover-commun
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_C

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Multiplied by a Power of X.** For any polynomial $p$ over a semiring and any natural numbers $n$ and $d$, the coefficient of $X^{d+n}$ in the polynomial $p \cdot X^n$ is equal to the coefficient of $X^d$ in $p$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3e1b9fd4485e
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_mul_ofNat - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Multiplied by a Natural Number.** For any polynomial $p$ over a semiring $R$ and any natural number $a \ge 2$, the $k$-th coefficient of the product of $p$ and the constant $a$ is equal to the $k$-th coefficient of $p$ multiplied by $a$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c24
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_ofNat

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_mul_intCast - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Multiplied by an Integer.** For any polynomial $p$ over a ring $S$ and any integer $a$, the $k$-th coefficient of the product of $p$ and the constant polynomial $a$ is equal to the $k$-th coefficient of $p$ multiplied by the image of $a$ in $S$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_intCast

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow' - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Multiplied by a Power of X.** For a polynomial $p$ over a semiring $R$ and natural numbers $n$ and $d$, the coefficient of $X^d$ in the polynomial $p \cdot X^n$ is equal to the coefficient of $X^{d-n}$ in $p$ if $n \le d$, and is $0$ otherwise. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e3
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow'

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_mul_natCast - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Polynomial Multiplied by a Natural Number.** For any polynomial $p$ over a semiring $R$ and any natural number $a$, the $k$-th coefficient of the product of $p$ and the constant $a$ is equal to the product of the $k$-th coefficient of $p$ and the image of $a$ in $R$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mat

results.match: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_X - [Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Basic] - **Coefficient of a Multivariate Polynomial Multiplied by a Variable.** For any multivariate polynomial $p$, any variable $X_s$, and any monomial $m$, the coefficient of $m \cdot X_s$ in the product $p \cdot X_s$ is equal to the coefficient of $m$ in $p$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5ca
results.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_X

results.match: Polynomial.coeff_C_mul - [Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Coeff] - **Coefficient of a Constant Multiple of a Polynomial.** For any polynomial $p$ over a semiring $R$ and any constant $a \in R$, the $n$-th coefficient of the product of the constant polynomial $a$ and $p$ is equal to $a$ times the $n$-th coefficient of $p$. - https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/e336692c249fa8d3928f5cad3
results.name: Polynomial.coeff_C_mul
